raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
The TE op-fuser builds its quantizers from the ambient autocast recipe, so a --te-precision-config-file override that keeps the experts quantized but with a different recipe (e.g. MXFP8 MTP experts under a global NVFP4 recipe) was ignored by the fused kernels: forward ran under NVFP4 while the module and its GTP gather were MXFP8, and backward then failed in the NVFP4 amax lookup.

Enter the module's own quantization autocast around the fused call, exactly as TEGroupedLinear.forward does on the unfused path. fc1 and fc2 must carry the same override since fusion spans both. A bf16 override still disables fusion.

Requires the matching Transformer Engine change that quantizes GTP-gathered BF16 weights inside the fused grouped MLP.

@@ -348,10 +348,12 @@ def __init__(
             name=(name + ".linear_fc2") if name is not None else None,
         )
 
-        # The fused grouped-MLP kernels are FP8/NVFP4-only and take their recipe from the global
-        # autocast state, so they would ignore a --te-precision-config-file override and quantize
-        # anyway -- silently under plain TE, fatally under GTP, whose backward then hands the
-        # kernel an unquantized weight. Fusion spans fc1 and fc2, so either one opting out ends it.
+        # The fused grouped-MLP kernels are FP8/NVFP4-only. A --te-precision-config-file override
+        # that turns the experts bf16 therefore disables fusion; a quantized override (e.g. MXFP8
+        # experts under a global NVFP4 recipe) keeps fusion and is applied by entering the module's
+        # own quantization autocast around the fused call (see _fused_quant_context), exactly as
+        # TEGroupedLinear.forward does on the unfused path. Fusion spans fc1 and fc2, so either one
+        # opting out ends it.
         self._with_fused_impl: bool = (
             self.config.use_transformer_engine_op_fuser
             and self.linear_fc1.will_execute_quantized(is_context_quantized=True)
@@ -910,6 +912,28 @@ def _get_paged_stash_scope(self, permuted_local_hidden_states, tokens_per_expert
             avg_num_tokens=avg_num_tokens,
         )
 
+    def _fused_quant_context(self):
+        """Quantization autocast for the fused grouped-MLP call.
+
+        The TE op fuser builds its quantizers from the ambient autocast recipe, not from the
+        per-module ``te_quant_params`` that ``TEGroupedLinear.forward`` would apply on the unfused
+        path. Enter the same per-module context here so a --te-precision-config-file override
+        (e.g. MXFP8 experts under a global NVFP4 recipe) is honored by the fused kernels and their
+        backward. Fusion spans fc1 and fc2, so both must carry the same override.
+        """
+        from megatron.core.extensions.transformer_engine import _get_fp8_autocast_for_quant_params
+
+        qparams_fc1 = getattr(self.linear_fc1, "te_quant_params", None)
+        qparams_fc2 = getattr(self.linear_fc2, "te_quant_params", None)
+        if qparams_fc1 is None and qparams_fc2 is None:
+            return nullcontext()
+        if qparams_fc1 != qparams_fc2:
+            raise RuntimeError(
+                "Fused GroupedMLP requires linear_fc1 and linear_fc2 to share the same "
+                f"quantization override; got {qparams_fc1} and {qparams_fc2}."
+            )
+        return _get_fp8_autocast_for_quant_params(qparams_fc1, self.training)
+
     def _fused_forward(
         self,
         permuted_local_hidden_states: torch.Tensor,
@@ -981,7 +1005,7 @@ def _fused_forward(
         fused_group_mlp_manager = off_interface(
             fine_grained_activation_offloading, permuted_local_hidden_states, offload_name
         )
-        with fused_group_mlp_manager as permuted_local_hidden_states:
+        with self._fused_quant_context(), fused_group_mlp_manager as permuted_local_hidden_states:
             # NCCL-EP zero-copy is active exactly when ``output_buffer`` is not None, and then the
             # fused-MLP input aliases the persistent symm buffer (also the fc2 output combine
             # reads), whose storage is non-resizable — so skip the force-release in that case.

+        global NVFP4 recipe). ``_fused_quant_context`` presents the module recipe to the op
+        fuser, so the fused forward and backward must quantize with MXFP8 and replay bit-exactly
+        under stream contention; the quantizer check guards against silently inheriting NVFP4."""
+        if torch.cuda.get_device_capability()[0] < 10:
+            pytest.skip("fused grouped MLP under MXFP8 / NVFP4 needs SM100+")

+        from transformer_engine.pytorch import MXFP8Quantizer
+        from transformer_engine.pytorch.ops import GroupedLinear

+            available, reason = probe(return_reason=True)
+            if not available:
+                pytest.skip(reason)
+        monkeypatch.setenv("NVTE_CUTEDSL_FUSED_GROUPED_MLP", "1")
+        self._init()
+        seeded()
+        quant_recipe = RecipeConfig.from_config_dict(
+            {
+                "configs": {
+                    "mxfp8": {
+                        "transformer_engine_config_type": "TEQuantizationParams",
+                        "training_recipe": {"fp8_quantization_recipe": "mxfp8"},
+                    }
+                },
+                "matchers": {
+                    "experts_mxfp8": {
+                        "type": "glob",
+                        "enabled": True,
+                        "pattern": "*experts*",
+                        "config": "mxfp8",
+                    }
+                },
+            }
+        )
+        config = _moe_config(
+            hidden_size=2048,
+            ffn_hidden_size=4096,
+            gated_linear_unit=False,
+            activation_func=squared_relu,
+            bias_activation_fusion=False,
+            use_fused_weighted_squared_relu=True,
+            use_transformer_engine_op_fuser=True,
+            fp8="e4m3",
+            fp8_recipe="nvfp4",
+            quant_recipe=quant_recipe,
+        )
+        spec = get_gpt_layer_with_transformer_engine_spec(num_experts=8, moe_grouped_gemm=True)
+        with get_fp8_context(config, is_init=True):
+            # The override is resolved by module path, so the experts need their name populated.
+            experts = get_submodules(spec.submodules.mlp).experts(
+                num_local_experts=8,
+                config=config,
+                pg_collection=ProcessGroupCollection.use_mpu_process_groups(),
+                name="mlp.experts",
+            )
+        assert isinstance(experts, TEGroupedMLP)
+        assert experts._with_fused_impl, "a quantized override must keep fusion"
+        assert experts.linear_fc1.te_quant_params is not None
+        assert experts.linear_fc1.te_quant_params == experts.linear_fc2.te_quant_params
+        experts = experts.cuda()
+        tokens_per_expert = torch.tensor([4096, 17, 0, 2048, 1, 8191, 33, 1998], dtype=torch.int64)
+        rows = int(tokens_per_expert.sum())
+        hidden = torch.randn(rows, 2048, device="cuda", dtype=torch.bfloat16, requires_grad=True)
+        probs = torch.rand(rows, device="cuda", requires_grad=True)
+
+        class _InNVFP4Autocast(torch.nn.Module):
+            def __init__(self, module):
+                super().__init__()
+                self.module = module
+
+            def forward(self, *args):
+                with te.fp8_autocast(enabled=True, fp8_recipe=NVFP4BlockScaling()):
+                    return self.module(*args)
+
+        assert_module_replays_bit_exact(

+            (hidden, tokens_per_expert, probs),

+            what="TEGroupedMLP[op fuser, MXFP8 override under NVFP4 autocast]",
+        )
+        # The grouped GEMMs quantized with the module's MXFP8 recipe, not the ambient NVFP4 one.
+        # Without the CuTeDSL kernel TE runs the same ops unfused, so walk both op layouts.
+        (sequential,) = experts._fused_ops
+        grouped_linears = [
+            basic
+            for op, _ in sequential._module_groups[0]._forward_ops
+            for basic in getattr(op, "basic_ops", [op])
+            if isinstance(basic, GroupedLinear)
+        ]
+        assert len(grouped_linears) == 2, grouped_linears
+        for fc in grouped_linears:
+            assert isinstance(fc.get_quantizer("forward", 1), MXFP8Quantizer)
+

@@ -468,6 +468,163 @@ def _worker_egtp_precision_override_backward(
         ps.initialize_model_parallel()
 
 
+def _mxfp8_override_recipe(pattern):
+    """A te-precision-config recipe keeping `pattern` quantized, but with MXFP8."""
+    from megatron.core.quantization.quant_config import RecipeConfig
+
+    return RecipeConfig.from_config_dict(
+        {
+            "configs": {
+                "mxfp8": {
+                    "transformer_engine_config_type": "TEQuantizationParams",
+                    "training_recipe": {"fp8_quantization_recipe": "mxfp8"},
+                }
+            },
+            "matchers": {
+                "mxfp8": {"type": "glob", "enabled": True, "pattern": pattern, "config": "mxfp8"}
+            },
+        }
+    )
+
+
+def _te_fused_grouped_mlp_quantizes_gathered_bf16() -> bool:
+    """Whether TE's fused grouped MLP quantizes a distributed weight it re-gathers as BF16.
+
+    A capability probe rather than a version check: the fix landed with the helper below and is
+    not tied to a TE release yet. Without it, EGTP_remat-sharded experts under a quantized
+    override raise AttributeError on ``_columnwise_data`` in the fused backward.
+    """
+    try:
+        from transformer_engine.pytorch.ops.fused import grouped_mlp
+    except ImportError:
+        return False
+    return hasattr(grouped_mlp, "_quantize_unquantized_weights")
+
+
+def _worker_egtp_quantized_precision_override_backward(rank, world_size, port, egtp_remat_size):
+    """EGTP_remat experts kept *fused* by an MXFP8 override under a global NVFP4 recipe.
+
+    Production repro: MTP experts routed to MXFP8 by ``--te-precision-config-file`` while the
+    run is NVFP4. Unlike a bf16 override, a quantized override keeps ``_with_fused_impl`` True,
+    so the fused call must (a) enter the module's MXFP8 autocast rather than inherit NVFP4 and
+    (b) with EGTP_remat sharding, have TE quantize the BF16 shards it re-gathers in backward
+    (the override creates no native-quantized params). Pre-fix this raised AttributeError in
+    the fused backward: ``_amax_columnwise`` without (a), ``_columnwise_data`` without (b).
+    Once TE has (b), missing (a) no longer crashes but silently runs NVFP4, hence the quantizer
+    assertion below. ``egtp_remat_size=1`` is the unsharded control.
+    """
+    from transformer_engine.common.recipe import NVFP4BlockScaling
+    from transformer_engine.pytorch import MXFP8Quantizer
+
+    from megatron.core import parallel_state as ps
+    from megatron.core.activations import squared_relu
+    from megatron.core.models.gpt.moe_module_specs import get_moe_module_spec
+    from megatron.core.process_groups_config import ProcessGroupCollection
+    from megatron.core.tensor_parallel.random import model_parallel_cuda_manual_seed
+    from megatron.core.transformer.moe.experts import TEGroupedMLP
+    from megatron.core.transformer.transformer_config import TransformerConfig
+
+    HIDDEN, FFN, NUM_EXPERTS, SEQ = 512, 256, 4, 16
+    dtype = torch.bfloat16
+    name = "mtp.layers.0.mlp"
+
+    ps.destroy_model_parallel()
+    ps.initialize_model_parallel(
+        tensor_model_parallel_size=1,
+        pipeline_model_parallel_size=1,
+        expert_model_parallel_size=1,
+        expert_gtp_remat_size=egtp_remat_size,
+    )
+    model_parallel_cuda_manual_seed(42)
+
+    config = TransformerConfig(
+        num_attention_heads=8,
+        num_layers=1,
+        hidden_size=HIDDEN,
+        num_moe_experts=NUM_EXPERTS,
+        moe_router_topk=2,
+        moe_ffn_hidden_size=FFN,
+        moe_grouped_gemm=True,
+        moe_token_dispatcher_type="alltoall",
+        moe_aux_loss_coeff=0.0,
+        moe_router_load_balancing_type="none",
+        add_bias_linear=False,
+        # Production expert path (fused weighted squared-ReLU): forms the CuTeDSL fused op
+        # without the 32-wide GLU interleave the GLU variant would need.
+        gated_linear_unit=False,
+        activation_func=squared_relu,
+        use_fused_weighted_squared_relu=True,
+        bias_activation_fusion=False,
+        params_dtype=dtype,
+        bf16=True,
+        hidden_dropout=0.0,
+        bias_dropout_fusion=False,
+        tensor_model_parallel_size=1,
+        pipeline_model_parallel_size=1,
+        use_transformer_engine_op_fuser=True,
+        gradient_accumulation_fusion=True,
+        quant_recipe=_mxfp8_override_recipe("*mtp.layers.*"),
+    )
+
+    moe_pg = get_default_pg_collection()
+    moe_pg.expt_gtp_remat = ProcessGroupCollection.use_mpu_process_groups(
+        required_pgs=['expt_gtp_remat']
+    ).expt_gtp_remat
+    assert moe_pg.expt_gtp_remat.size() == egtp_remat_size
+
+    moe_spec = get_moe_module_spec(use_te=True, num_experts=NUM_EXPERTS, moe_grouped_gemm=True)
+    layer = moe_spec(config, layer_number=1, pg_collection=moe_pg, name=name).cuda()
+
+    try:
+        experts = layer.experts
+        assert isinstance(experts, TEGroupedMLP)
+        # A quantized override keeps the op-fuser path, unlike the bf16 one.
+        assert experts._with_fused_impl
+        sharded = any(isinstance(p, GTPShardedParam) for p in experts.parameters())
+        assert sharded == (egtp_remat_size > 1)
+
+        for p in experts.parameters():
+            if p.requires_grad and not hasattr(p, "main_grad"):
+                p.main_grad = torch.zeros_like(p.data, dtype=torch.float32)
+
+        x = torch.randn((SEQ, 1, HIDDEN), dtype=dtype, device="cuda", requires_grad=True)
+        with fp8_autocast(enabled=True, fp8_recipe=NVFP4BlockScaling()):
+            output, _ = layer(x)
+        # The CuTeDSL fused op must actually have formed (after the lazy first forward); the
+        # basic-op fallback would not exercise the fused weight plumbing this test is about.
+        (sequential,) = experts._fused_ops
+        selected = [
+            type(entry[0] if isinstance(entry, (tuple, list)) else entry).__name__
+            for group in sequential._module_groups
+            for entry in group._forward_ops
+        ]
+        assert any(name.startswith("GroupedMLP_CuTeGEMM") for name in selected), selected
+        # ... and it quantized with the module's MXFP8 recipe, not the ambient NVFP4 one. With a
+        # TE that quantizes re-gathered BF16 shards, inheriting NVFP4 here would not crash; it
+        # would silently run these experts in the wrong precision.
+        fused_op = next(
+            entry[0] if isinstance(entry, (tuple, list)) else entry
+            for group in sequential._module_groups
+            for entry in group._forward_ops
+            if type(entry[0] if isinstance(entry, (tuple, list)) else entry).__name__.startswith(
+                "GroupedMLP_CuTeGEMM"
+            )
+        )
+        for fc in (fused_op.basic_ops[0], fused_op.basic_ops[-1]):
+            assert isinstance(fc.get_quantizer("forward", 1), MXFP8Quantizer), type(
+                fc.get_quantizer("forward", 1)
+            )
+        output.float().mean().backward()
+
+        assert x.grad is not None and torch.isfinite(x.grad).all()
+        assert any(
+            p.main_grad.abs().sum() > 0 for p in experts.parameters() if hasattr(p, "main_grad")
+        ), "no expert wgrad reached main_grad"
+    finally:
+        ps.destroy_model_parallel()
+        ps.initialize_model_parallel()
+
+
